newsitem.title: USA: Shoney's holders offer director slate.
newsitem.headline: Shoney's holders offer director slate.

text.p: The Shoney's Shareholders Committee said Monday it is filing amended proxy materials with the Securities and Exchange Commission to disclose its slate of seven nominees for election to Shoney's Inc's board at a special shareholders meeting.

The committee is composed of two shareholders, Raymond Schoenbaum and Betty Shoenbaum, the son and wife of the restaurant chain's founder. Collectively they own 3.9 million Shoney's shares, about 8 percent of those outstanding.

The committee has retained MacKenzie Partners Inc to assist it with efforts to call a special shareholders meeting for August 19. They note Shoney's bylaws and the Tennessee Business Corporation Act require at least 10 percent of a company's shareholders to call a special meeting.
Besides Raymond Schoenbaum, the naminees are:
-- Michael Bodnar, president of Bodnar Investement Group;
-- Lawrence Cunningham, profersor of law, Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law;
-- Nathaniel Goldston III, chief executive of The Gourmet Co;
-- Michael Leven, chief executive of U.S. Franchise Systems Inc ;
-- William Schwartz, chief executive First Media Television LP; and
-- Richard Sherman, an investor and consultant.
